turns.user: is my stuff covered if it breaks?
turns.bot: We offer a 2-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects on items like tents, backpacks, and jackets. If your item breaks due to a manufacturing defect, you can contact us and we'll repair or replace it for you. Just send an email to support@pinecrest-outfitters.example with your order number and a photo of the defect, and we'll take care of it.
